chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from 'Asim, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام ruled regarding the old man and the old woman that they be flogged one hundred lashes, and he ruled stoning for the muhsan, and he ruled regarding the virgin man and the virgin woman, when they commit zina, one hundred lashes and banishment for one year to other than their town.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام as leader of the believers
key_terms.الشَّيْخَةِ: the old woman, mentioned here as a legal category in the ruling
key_terms.الشَّيْخِ: the old man, mentioned here as a legal category in the ruling
key_terms.الْبِكْرَةِ: the virgin woman, meaning one not previously married
key_terms.الْبِكْرِ: the virgin man, meaning one not previously married
key_terms.الْمُحْصَنِ: the legally protected married person in the context of zina rulings
key_terms.قَضَى: he ruled or passed judgment in a legal case
key_terms.نَفْيَ سَنَةٍ: banishment for one year as part of the legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What ruling is narrated from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام regarding the hadd punishments for zina?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام concerning hadd punishments for zina in different cases. It distinguishes between categories such as the muhsan and the unmarried virgin man and woman, and mentions flogging, stoning, and exile as judicial penalties.
